Maya S: Heads up — ACME reported a surprise invoice jump. They say a single batch job retried and doubled token usage overnight. I pulled the customer logs and saw several identical request_ids hitting our ingress within a 90s window.
Tom (ACME): Yep — one scheduled job hit a 504, client retried then got a success. Our app uses an ephemeral idempotency token (UUID per attempt) rather than a stable key across retries. We thought our client retry would dedupe on the server side.
Josh B: Can you paste a sample request/headers? Specifically Idempotency-Key or x-idempotency headers.
Maya S: Sample (redacted):
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx
Idempotency-Key: a3f4-... (varies per attempt)
User-Agent: acme-batch/1.2
x-client-retry: 1
```
Olivia R: Two quick things to check — (1) did the gateway forward the Idempotency-Key header to the runtime/ledger service? (2) did the gateway itself perform retries on timeout and re-issue the request server-side without preserving the idempotency key or without consulting the ledger?
Maya S: From the request trace I can see the gateway response log shows internal retry attempts: `gateway: retrying request to runtime after 504 (attempt 2)`. The forwarded header list shows `idempotency-key` present on first try, but on the second forwarded call it's missing in the runtime logs.
Sam (eng-sre): That suggests header stripping during gateway's internal replay. We have a known fast-path where we drop certain headers for replayed internal calls unless annotated. I'll pull recent deploy diffs against the gateway.
Tom (ACME): Can we get a quick fix? We were charged ~2x for ~30 minutes of job runs.
Josh B: Short-term: I'm flagging this for a manual billing adjustment — billing-bot, please create a pro-rated credit for ACME account with note: "duplicate meter detected due to gateway replay header loss".
billing-bot: Created credit #CR-2026-482 for account acme-corp: -$2,184. Waiting approval.
Olivia R: Longer term: two action items: (A) ensure gateway preserves `Idempotency-Key` and any `x-idempotency-*` headers across internal retries; (B) patch runtime ledger to infer dedupe using (request_id || user+model+prompt hash) as fallback when no explicit key present.
Sam (eng-sre): I found the firewall rule in gateway that removes headers matching `^X-Internal-.*` and a bug where header canonicalization lowercased and dropped `Idempotency-Key` on replays. I'll push a hotfix to preserve those headers for replayed calls and add integration test.
Maya S: I'll send ACME a status update and confirm the credit once approved. Also requesting their SDK team to adopt stable Idempotency-Key across retries; sample code suggestion:
```
const key = jobId; // stable per job
axios.post(url, body, { headers: { 'Idempotency-Key': key }})
```
Tom (ACME): Thanks — we'll change the client. Appreciate the quick rollback offer.
Josh B: Followups: (1) confirm credit applied (2) close incident after hotfix deploy + regression test (3) add monitoring alert for identical payloads from same customer within short window.
Maya S: Ack. I'll update thread when credit posts and when Sam confirms deploy.
